shortDescription: Module to manage storage domains in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: backup
options.description: Boolean flag which indicates whether the storage domain is configured as backup or not.

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment of the storage domain.

options.name: critical_space_action_blocker
options.description: Indicates the minimal free space the storage domain should contain in percentages.

options.name: data_center
options.description: Data center name where storage domain should be attached. This parameter isn't idempotent, it's not possible to change data center of storage domain.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the storage domain.

options.name: destroy
options.description: Logical remove of the storage domain. If I(true) retains the storage domain's data for import. This parameter is relevant only when C(state) is I(absent).

options.name: discard_after_delete
options.description: If I(True) storage domain blocks will be discarded upon deletion. Enabled by default. This parameter is relevant only for block based storage domains.

options.name: domain_function
options.description: Function of the storage domain. This parameter isn't idempotent, it's not possible to change domain function of storage domain.

options.name: fcp
options.description: Dictionary with values for fibre channel storage type: Note that these parameters are not idempotent.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: format
options.description: If I(True) storage domain will be formatted after removing it from oVirt/RHV. This parameter is relevant only when C(state) is I(absent).

options.name: glusterfs
options.description: Dictionary with values for GlusterFS storage type: Note that these parameters are not idempotent.

options.name: host
options.description: Host to be used to mount storage.

options.name: id
options.description: Id of the storage domain to be imported.

options.name: iscsi
options.description: Dictionary with values for iSCSI storage type: Note that these parameters are not idempotent.

options.name: localfs
options.description: Dictionary with values for localfs storage type: Note that these parameters are not idempotent.

options.name: managed_block_storage
options.description: Dictionary with values for managed block storage type Note: available from ovirt 4.3

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the storage domain to manage. (Not required when state is I(imported))

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: nfs
options.description: Dictionary with values for NFS storage type: Note that these parameters are not idempotent.

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: posixfs
options.description: Dictionary with values for PosixFS storage type: Note that these parameters are not idempotent.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the storage domain be present/absent/maintenance/unattached/imported/update_ovf_store I(imported) is supported since version 2.4. I(update_ovf_store) is supported since version 2.5, currently if C(wait) is (true), we don't wait for update.

options.name: storage_format
options.description: One of v1, v2, v3, v4, v5 - sets the storage format of the domain.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.

options.name: warning_low_space
options.description: Indicates the minimum percentage of a free space in a storage domain to present a warning.

options.name: wipe_after_delete
options.description: Boolean flag which indicates whether the storage domain should wipe the data after delete.
